subject: Automotive & EVs
title: Silicon Anodes
description: A quick, practical guide to Silicon Anodes.

hook.text: Most lithium-ion anodes use graphite, but silicon can absorb ten times more lithium per gram.

buildup.text: Replacing graphite with silicon could roughly double a battery's energy density overnight.

discovery.text: The problem is that silicon expands by 300 percent when it absorbs lithium, cracking the cell apart.

twist.text: Engineers are mixing small amounts of silicon into graphite—getting partial gains without full cracking.

climax.text: Startups like Sila and Amprius have shipped silicon-rich anodes to EV and drone makers already.

punchline.text: Silicon's massive expansion is both its superpower and its weakness.

quiz.question: Why is pure silicon problematic as a battery anode?
options: It expands 300 percent when absorbing lithium
